Bouncing Bluster II (1990).note:
After you get past the title screen you will get a message to "Insert Data Disk". Select "Abort" and then double click the "Level" folder. Select the script you wish to play.
There is also a sound issue. In order to fix it press "Cancel" when you can choose 1 or 2 players. Press Alt+s, and then drag the volume slider up and press ok. Then press Alt+n to get back to the player number choice.

ExplorerGS (1991).note:
If you wish to read the authors notes double click "Explorer.Docs", otherwise to play the modules created by the author of ExplorerGS double click "ExplorerGS". Under "File", "Load Game" you can then select "Islands", "Lyle.Valley", or "Nor.Forest". You then need to "Load Character" and will need to double click the "Characters" folder to then select one. Now you can select "Game" and "Play".
To play other user created adventures you can load ExplorerGS as above and this time double click to "Adventures" folder when selecting "Load Game". Select a module and then follow the other instructions above re loading a character (click the little down arrow above the folder selection to navigate back up the folder tree to get to the "Characters" folder) and starting the game.
The other option is to play a user created total conversion adventure. To do this instead of running "ExplorerGS", open one of the folders on the right under the heading "Adventures2". Each of these will have a file with "GS" in the name and, if the module author wrote some notes, a document file next to it you can open to read. Run the "GS" file and then follow the other instructions as above to open the module found in the same folder and load a character.
Lastly, you can create your own characters or modules by using "GameMakerGS" which has some documentation in the file next to the executable.

Future Shock 3D (1989).note:
This game was made for a peripheral called the "Future Pad". The game used the device to make the in game ball jump. A hacked version that bypasses the "Future Pad" interface has been made, and this is the version included.
To control the ball use the mouse to move and "2" on the numpad to jump.

Once Upon a Time III (1990).note:
When you are asked to insert Disk 3, press "F4". From this menu select "Disk Configuration". Highlight "s5d2", then press "e" to simulate ejecting the disk. You will need to press "F4" again to process the eject.
Now press "Ok". This will fail, but seems to be necessary. Then press "F4" again and go back to the disk config. Select "s5d2" and then select "Disk3.2mg". Finally press "F4" to exit back to the game, click "ok", and continue play.
Do this as required for disk swaps.
To load a sample book select the "File" dropdown, select "Load", then use the "Disk" button to navigate to Disk 1. Double click "Dragon.Tale".
